target_customer: Enterprise and mid-market sales organizations that pay for rep training and coaching
problem: Sales reps ramp slowly and managers cannot coach every call. Hyperbound lets reps practice against AI buyers and scores real calls to show what top performers do.
product_category: AI sales coaching and roleplay, revenue enablement

founders.name: Sriharsha (Sai) Guduguntla
founders.background_notes: YC page: self-taught full-stack engineer and designer with 12+ years building products.

founders.name: Atul Raghunathan
founders.background_notes: YC page: AI engineer and language model researcher who built ML personalization systems; employers and education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: In mid 2023 realistic voice roleplay with large language models needed prompt design, low latency speech and scoring, which was doable for two AI engineers but not trivial.

defensibility.rationale: Roleplay on top of public LLMs is copyable. Integration with CRM and call data and enterprise rollouts add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent enablement and conversation intelligence vendors added roleplay modules by 2025 (Mindtickle blog), but Hyperbound still raised a Series A in September 2025. No acquisition found.

market_need_then: Not sourced from 2023 pages. The company site now claims 100,000+ reps and ramp 50% faster; these are vendor claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses hyperbound.ai; it is not an exact .com, per the company website.

identity.mascot_or_character: Kota, an AI revenue assistant launched December 2025 (product persona)

branding.brand_signature: AI buyers that rehearse calls with reps

brand_strength.rationale: Review sites and trade comparisons name Hyperbound as a leader in cold call roleplay, but no source shows brand-led virality, community or merch.

outcome_analysis: Hyperbound launched out of YC Summer 2023 into the generative AI wave and raised a $15M Series A led by Peak XV in September 2025. Named enterprise customers on its site and a move from roleplay to a revenue activation platform with the Kota agent drove its story. The main risk is incumbents bundling roleplay. No shutdown or sale found.
notes: Unverified aggregator figures: a $3.3M seed (Fellows Fund, Rebel Fund, Roble Ventures) and totals of $17.5M or $18.3M appear only on aggregators, so no seed round is recorded. Series A is confirmed by YourStory and an AccessWire press release syndicated copy. A dated competitor search returned only 2025 and 2026 comparison pages, so the list is empty. The Village Voice piece and the legal entity IntelligentSystems Corp were not used for facts.
